requested_command:
set -eu
printf 'guest_utc='; date -u +%FT%TZ
printf 'hostname='; hostname
printf 'kernel_full='; uname -a
printf 'arch='; uname -m
printf '%s\n' '--- /etc/os-release ---'
cat /etc/os-release
printf '%s\n' '--- /etc/kylin-release ---'
cat /etc/kylin-release 2>/dev/null || echo NONE
printf '%s\n' '--- python ---'
python3 --version
printf '%s\n' '--- systemd ---'
systemctl --version | head -1
printf '%s\n' '--- disk_root ---'
df -h / | tail -1
printf '%s\n' '--- user ---'
id
printf '%s\n' '--- no-project-residue ---'
test -d /home/kylin-agent/kylinOS-agent-memory && echo CHECKOUT_PRESENT || echo NO_CHECKOUT
ls -d /home/kylin-agent/.local/share/kylin-memory* 2>/dev/null || echo NO_MEMORY_PREFIX
ls -l /home/kylin-agent/.local/bin/kylin-memory-server 2>/dev/null || echo NO_STALE_LAUNCHER
systemctl --user is-active kylin-memory 2>/dev/null || echo UNIT_INACTIVE
ls -l /run/user/1000/kylin-memory/memory.sock 2>/dev/null || echo NO_MEMORY_SOCK
find /home/kylin-agent -maxdepth 3 -type d \( -name '.venv' -o -name 'build*' -o -name 'kylin-memory-d14a' \) 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true
